theorem QOU.KZ.KZHalfMonodromy.half_monodromy {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℂ R] [CompleteSpace R] (A B : R) (hinj : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → Function.Injective (FuchsianFormal.indicial A k)) (H₀ H : ℕ → R) (h₀ : H₀ 0 = 1) (hH₀ : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A B) H₀) (h0 : H 0 = 1) (hH : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A (-A - B)) H) :
Set.EqOn (fun (z : ℂ) => KZComplex.G₁ A H (rho (rho z))) (fun (z : ℂ) => KZComplex.G₀ A H₀ z * NormedSpace.exp ℂ (-(↑Real.pi * Complex.I) • A)) T

KZComplex.IsKZSolOn A B (fun (z : ℂ) => KZComplex.G₁ A H (rho (rho z))) T

KZComplex.cpowA A (-z / (1 - z)) = KZComplex.cpowA (-A) (1 - z) * (KZComplex.cpowA A z * NormedSpace.exp ℂ (-(↑Real.pi * Complex.I) • A))
